name: New terrains
description:
Expands the adventure map with 11 distinctive terrains:
• Dead Land
• Fields of Glory
• Fiery Land
• Heather Thicket
• Ice Sheet
• Pasturage
• Plateau
• Shallows
• Spoiled Land
• Stardust
• Terrace
author: Ben Yan, zeryss, Kurek
